# Check the years for darryl dawkins and paul dawkins
darryl_years = df[df['player'] == 'darryl dawkins']['years for jazz'].iloc[0]
paul_years = df[df['player'] == 'paul dawkins']['years for jazz'].iloc[0]

# Extract start years from the 'years for jazz' strings
# Assuming format like "1979 - 86" or "1993 , 1994 - 95"
def extract_start_year(year_str):
    # Split by common delimiters and take the first part
    # Remove any commas and split by spaces or hyphens
    parts = year_str.replace(',', '').split()
    # The first part should be the start year
    start = parts[0]
    # Convert to integer
    return int(start)

darryl_start = extract_start_year(darryl_years)
paul_start = extract_start_year(paul_years)

# Check if darryl dawkins played seven years before paul dawkins
answer = (paul_start - darryl_start) == 7
